name: homedash
description: A single-user dashboard for a Proxmox homelab: guest control with scenes and schedules, health score, backup and snapshot protection, capacity forecasts, network map and an nginx manager. Features such as Grafana, Loki logs, CrowdSec, a database manager, OIDC sign-in and two-step login switch on from one YAML file.

app_vars.name: var_homedash_admin_password
app_vars.label: Admin password (min 12 characters, random if empty)

app_vars.name: var_homedash_pve_node
app_vars.label: Proxmox node name
app_vars.help: Defaults to the hostname of the Proxmox host running the script

app_vars.name: var_homedash_grafana_url
app_vars.label: Grafana URL
app_vars.help: Optional. Lets homedash browse and embed Grafana dashboards

app_vars.name: var_homedash_loki_url
app_vars.label: Loki URL
app_vars.help: Optional. Turns on Logs > Analytics and Loki search

app_vars.name: var_homedash_config_b64
app_vars.label: Full homedash.yaml (base64)
app_vars.help: Optional. Replaces the questions above: var_homedash_config_b64=$(base64 -w0 homedash.yaml)

notes.text: Everything is configured in /etc/homedash/homedash.yaml. Run `homedash-config validate` to see which features are on, then `homedash-config apply --restart`. All options: /opt/homedash/infra/homedash.example.yaml
The admin password is printed once at the end of the install. Reset it with: cd /opt/homedash/server && npm run create-user -- admin admin
Create the Proxmox API token with tools/pve/create-token.sh (PVEAuditor and PVEVMUser roles).
Optional host-side add-ons (Alloy log shipping, CrowdSec snapshot, node exporter): run tools/pve/host-addons.sh <ctid> on the Proxmox host. Nothing is installed without confirmation.
Runs over plain HTTP with secure cookies off. Behind an HTTPS reverse proxy set server.https: true (the nginx.homedash block can render the proxy for you).
